A new lottery system lets eligible players enter for a chance to buy the console, with applicants needing at least 60 hours of PS4/PS5 playtime.

And with GTA 6 just weeks away, the timing definitely caught the gaming community’s attention. 🎮🌴

Sony hasn't said this is related to GTA 6, but you can imagine why fans are already wondering:

How many people are upgrading their setup before Vice City? 👀
